ravnai.name: Ravnai
ravnai.bio: Amora who transmits teachings in the name of Shmuel.
ravnai.prompt: A Babylonian sage in his 50s with a greying dark beard and an olive-green wool mantle, reciting a ruling he received from his teacher with one finger raised; background of a mud-brick study hall lit by an oil lamp.

rav-yehuda-bar-achotai.name: Rav Yehuda bar Aḥotai
rav-yehuda-bar-achotai.bio: Amora who rules in Keritot 13b that the halakha follows Rabbi Elazar.
rav-yehuda-bar-achotai.prompt: A sage in his 50s with a full brown beard and a plum-coloured wool mantle, stating a ruling with one open hand; background of a plain study hall with a scroll shelf and an oil lamp.
